## Next milestones

- [01.02.2027]{.datum} EU: sale of CBAM certificates begins
- [2028]{.datum} EU: ETS2 starts for buildings and transport
- [2030]{.datum} China: CO₂ peak · Germany: −65 % · EU: −55 %
- [2035]{.datum} China: net GHG −7 to −10 % below peak

[All milestones to 2060 →](ziele/index.qmd#milestones-to-2060)
:::

::: {.leitgedanke}
## Why this comparison?

Germany and China pursue ambitious climate targets with very different tools – law and carbon prices in one, five-year plans and intensity targets in the other. Through supply chains and the carbon border adjustment, the two systems are increasingly connected. This site sets them side by side: traceable, with primary sources and dates.
